original.target_description: Study 2, product-attitude left-versus-right contrast under modern shopping goals, evaluated within the six-cell ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the common 2 (position) × 3 (desirable attribute) product-attitude ANOVA supporting the target contrast; includes antique, modern, and control cells. Model analytic N, not condition-specific subgroup N.
n.exclusions: 15 manipulation-check failures removed; 179 participants retained in analysis. Condition-specific final cell counts not reported.
n.location: PDF p. 7 / printed p. 229, Study 2, Results and Discussion
n.quote:
Fifteen participants were unable to identify the shopping
goal in the manipulation check and were removed, leaving ... the responses of 179 participants in the analysis.

notes: Only assigned unfinished fields completed; other null fields and replication/success are unassigned placeholders. Target PDF pages 6–7 inspected. The modern contrast is explicitly named in the same paragraph and evaluated with the common ANOVA error term (printed t(173)). N=179 is directly stated for this analysis, not derived from degrees of freedom. No antique-only or modern-only N can be established. No arithmetic derivation used.
